hero.description: Expert in design systems (DSFR), accessibility (RGAA/WCAG) and the transformation of complex journeys. I help demanding organizations design digital experiences that deliver measurable business impact.
project.deli.description: Full design of the Délicorner Digital B2B portal, from high-fidelity functional prototypes to a bespoke design system. An end-to-end solo project, from product structure to internal AI tools for customer experience.
project.gouv.description: Adaptation and redesign of the priority policies page for the French government. An ambitious project aimed at improving accessibility and clarity of government information for all citizens.
project.agora.description: Complete application for wholesalers at the Rungis market combining order taking, solvency, electronic invoicing, and accounting. A complex B2B project aimed at digitalizing business processes.
project.gomind.description: Complete redesign of the showcase website for an IT services company specialized in GreenIT. Creation of a modern visual identity, an AI mascot generator, and a design system to improve B2B client acquisition.

v3.hero.title: Design systems that actually hold up.
v3.hero.sub: For your teams today, for AI tomorrow.
v3.board.title: Six products, six systems.
v3.board.hint: These aren't screenshots: click, drag, aim.
v3.ai.title: A system your teams and your tools can read.
v3.ai.lead: Before drawing screens, I structure what they are made of. Your developers benefit from week one. And the day you plug in an AI, it finds a clean system instead of guessing.
v3.ai.s1.d: Colors, spacing, type: named once, used everywhere.
v3.ai.s2.d: States, variants and accessibility rules built in from the start.
v3.ai.s3.d: Every decision is written down: handoff becomes a read, not a meeting.
v3.ai.calm: And what about AI? It stays a workshop tool: it proposes, you approve. You have nothing to adopt to work with me.
v3.pj.scrub: Move the mouse: the delivery moves along
